_about: Suggested Background patterns, grouped. Each pattern is a case-insensitive substring of the process name as ps shows it (at most 15 characters). Only processes you own are touched, so root daemons are left out on purpose. Adding a group is one new entry here; the Power tab picks it up.

groups.name: File indexers
groups.why: Crawl the whole disk and extract text from files, often right after login.

groups.name: Thumbnail makers
groups.why: Decode images and videos to draw previews whenever a folder is opened.

groups.name: App stores and update checkers
groups.why: Download metadata and updates in the background.

groups.name: Mail, calendar and online accounts
groups.why: Sync calendars, contacts and accounts on a timer even when the apps are closed.

groups.name: Cloud sync
groups.why: Hash and upload files; can hold a core busy during big changes.

groups.name: Desktop housekeeping
groups.why: Printer, sharing, disk-space and device-watch helpers that never need to be quick.

groups.name: Launcher and browser helpers
groups.why: Steam's built-in web views and browser crash or telemetry reporters.
